description:
Smart. Focused. Email.

Fast, cross-platform email designed to filter out the noise - so you can focus on what's important.
Auto-Drafts, now even more helpful
Need a reply to a specific message in a long thread? Open that message's menu and choose Auto-Draft a reply. Spark writes a reply to exactly that message.

When you give feedback on a draft using "Other," Spark now applies it right away, so you don't have to explain twice.

This update also includes stability fixes.

New to Auto-Drafts?
Spark can now drafts replies in your voice before you even open the email. When a message needs a response, Spark prepares the draft. Review, tweak, or send with one click. Nothing goes out without you.

Works across all your email accounts. Available with Spark Pro.

We'd love to hear how it goes. Share feedback at support@sparkmailapp.com.

P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.31.2.141057/Spark.exe
